usable_content: This study explicitly identifies a 'lack of methodological standardization' as a primary challenge in the field, noting that this generates observational inconsistencies and complicates causal inference. The authors state that future progress depends on 'large-scale, longitudinal, multiomics clinical trials using harmonized protocols.'
